styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting: confident black ink outlines, textured acrylic brushstrokes. Huge blazing orange, red and gold sunset or deep blue moonlit sky with tiny white dots like stars, figures as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.DOLSOE: a young Joseon servant man with a lean kind face in ragged patched gray hemp clothes and a worn straw hat
characters.CHOI: a fat greedy rich man with a thin mustache in a purple silk robe and black gat hat
characters.GUEST: a thin old traveling scholar with a white beard in a faded torn white robe and a torn black gat hat
characters.SATTO: an arrogant magistrate in a blue official robe and black winged official hat
characters.CHILD: a skinny little Joseon child in a worn patched hanbok

scenes.S01: [SIL] Dusk at a Joseon government courtyard crowded with villagers. In the center a fat rich man in a gat kneels on the ground before a standing ragged servant in a straw hat.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon government office courtyard at sunset, two clear roles: 1. LEFT, standing tall and calm: DOLSOE, barefoot, holding an old folding fan. 2. RIGHT, on his knees with forehead bowed toward the ground: CHOI, his silk robe dirty with mud. BACKGROUND: astonished villagers watching. The servant is the dignified one; the rich man is the one humbled.
scenes.S05: A peaceful Joseon village in Gyeongsang province seen from a hill: thatched-roof houses, one large tiled-roof mansion with a storehouse, rice paddies and blue mountains. No people.
scenes.S06: Early dawn, DOLSOE sweeps a mansion courtyard with a straw broom beside a steaming iron cauldron of cattle feed, a cow in the shed.
scenes.S07: CHOI stands proudly beside stacked rice sacks in front of his storehouse, gold rings on his fingers, smug expression.
scenes.S08: Inside a humble straw barn next to a cowshed, DOLSOE sits on straw holding a small cold ball of barley rice, smiling gently.
scenes.S09: Drought: a cracked dry rice paddy field with withered yellow rice stalks under a pale hot sky, a small village in the distance. No people.
scenes.S10: CHILD sits leaning against the crumbling mud wall of a tiny thatched hut, staring weakly at the sky, hungry.
scenes.S11: Close-up of two hands only: a rough servant's hand placing half of a barley rice ball into a small child's open hands. Warm light, only hands and sleeves visible.
scenes.S12: [SIL] Snowy winter evening in a Joseon village, heavy snow on thatched roofs, a single warm lantern glowing by a big wooden gate.
scenes.S13: [SIL] Snowy night at a big mansion gate: an old traveler collapsed in the snow outside while a fat man slams the gate shut, lantern light.
scenes.S14: [SIL] Snowy night, a young servant carrying an old man on his back through deep snow toward a small barn.
scenes.S15: [SIL] Inside a straw barn at night lit by one oil lamp: a young man spoon-feeding rice to an old man wrapped in a quilt, warm glow behind them.
scenes.S16: Morning light in an empty straw barn: an old worn folding fan lying on a crumpled cotton quilt on the straw. No people.
scenes.S17: DOLSOE carefully tucks an old closed folding fan into the front of his jacket, puzzled but grateful expression.
scenes.S18: [SIL] Blazing orange sunset over a quiet Joseon village with pine trees and roofs, an ominous calm.
scenes.S19: CHOI sits in his room counting a pile of brass coins with a greedy grin, rice sacks piled behind him.
scenes.S20: A line of thin, tired Joseon villagers holding empty cloth sacks and wooden bowls in front of a mansion gate in winter.
scenes.S21: A large Joseon government granary building with a tiled roof and a heavy locked wooden door, bare winter trees. No people.
scenes.S22: SATTO lounging lazily at a low table full of wine and food on a wooden veranda, waving his hand dismissively.
scenes.S23: [SIL] Moonlit night, a young servant carrying a small oil lamp walks toward a cowshed.
scenes.S24: [SIL] Moonlit night, a line of ox carts piled high with grain sacks quietly entering the back gate of a big mansion.
scenes.S25: [SIL] Night, several men carrying heavy grain sacks on their backs into a storehouse, led by a fat man holding a lantern.
scenes.S26: [SIL] Moonlight at a storehouse door: a fat man in a gat and an official in a winged hat leaning close and whispering.
scenes.S27: Night, DOLSOE hides behind the wooden wall of a cowshed, peeking out with a shocked face, soft moonlight keeps the scene readable.
scenes.S28: [SIL] Night in a cowshed: a wooden feeding trough tipped over, a lantern raised high throwing sharp light and long shadows.
scenes.S29: CHOI holds up a lantern in a dark yard, glaring angrily with narrowed eyes, his face clearly lit by the lantern.
scenes.S31: Dawn in a mansion courtyard, CHOI in white socks shouting furiously with both arms raised.
scenes.S32: [WEB] Scene inside a straw barn at dawn, three clear roles: 1. CENTER: two servants pulling two big rice sacks out of a straw pile. 2. RIGHT: DOLSOE standing with wide eyes and both hands raised in shock. 3. LEFT in the doorway: CHOI pointing angrily.
scenes.S33: CHOI points an accusing finger, face red with fake anger, in a mansion courtyard.
scenes.S34: [SIL] Village street at sunset, two guards dragging a bound young man away while villagers watch from the roadside.
scenes.S35: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon government office courtyard, three clear roles: 1. TOP, sitting on the raised wooden veranda: SATTO, arrogant. 2. BOTTOM CENTER, kneeling on the ground with hands tied behind his back: DOLSOE, looking up desperately. 3. RIGHT, standing beside the veranda: CHOI with silk sleeves rolled up, smirking.
scenes.S36: Close-up of DOLSOE kneeling with hands tied, shouting desperately with tears in his eyes.
scenes.S37: SATTO slams his fist on a low wooden table, furious red face, official hat tilted.
scenes.S38: [SIL] Inside a Joseon prison cell at night, moonlight through wooden bars, a young man hugging his knees.
scenes.S39: Close-up of wooden prison bars at night: a small child's hand reaching through the bars holding a round rice ball, soft moonlight.
scenes.S40: In a dim prison cell, DOLSOE holds an old closed folding fan in both hands, looking at it with teary eyes, moonlight on his face.
scenes.S41: [SIL] Night, the glowing paper sliding door of a rich man's room showing the shadows of two men raising wine cups.
scenes.S43: A busy Joseon market street with stalls, GUEST walks slowly among the villagers, looking around quietly.
scenes.S44: At a village well, GUEST stands a little apart listening carefully while two village women gossip beside water jars.
scenes.S45: [SIL] Moonlit night, an old scholar walking along long drag marks in the snow from an empty granary toward a mansion back gate.
scenes.S46: [SIL] Dark night alley, several men in merchant clothes gathering around an old scholar.
scenes.S47: Morning at a Joseon government courtyard: a wooden punishment bench in the center, crowds of villagers gathering, a little child clutching her grandmother's skirt.
scenes.S48: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon government office courtyard in the morning, three clear roles: 1. CENTER: DOLSOE lying face down, tied on a wooden punishment bench. 2. RIGHT: a guard raising a long wooden paddle. 3. TOP, on the veranda: SATTO shouting and CHOI smirking beside him. BACKGROUND: worried villagers.
scenes.S49: Close-up on the dirt ground of a courtyard: an old folding fan fallen and spread open, the shadow of a raised wooden paddle above it.
scenes.S50: [SIL] A crowd of villagers parting as an old scholar in a torn gat walks forward with his hand raised high.
scenes.S51: SATTO sneers and points with a mocking laugh from the wooden veranda.
scenes.S52: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon government office courtyard, three clear roles: 1. CENTER, standing tall: GUEST holding high a round bronze royal inspector's medallion engraved with horses. 2. AROUND HIM: several men dressed as merchants shouting with fists raised. 3. BACKGROUND: SATTO frozen in terror on the veranda. The old scholar is the powerful one.
scenes.S53: [SIL] Sunset over a Joseon government office in chaos: officials running away in all directions, one man crawling under a table.
scenes.S54: [WEB] Scene at an opened storehouse, two clear roles: 1. INSIDE: grain sacks stacked up to the ceiling, each marked with a red round stamp, an open wooden chest of account books. 2. FOREGROUND: CHOI pale and trembling with his mouth open. BACKGROUND: officers holding the doors open.
scenes.S55: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon government office courtyard, two clear roles: 1. STANDING TALL: GUEST holding a bronze medallion, stern. 2. KNEELING side by side on the ground before him with heads bowed: CHOI with a muddy silk robe and SATTO without his hat.
scenes.S56: Close-up of an old folding fan spread open on a wooden table, abstract black ink brush strokes and a square red seal stamp on the paper.
scenes.S57: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon government office courtyard, three clear roles: 1. LEFT: GUEST untying the ropes from DOLSOE's wrists and handing him an old folding fan. 2. CENTER: DOLSOE standing, deeply moved. 3. RIGHT, on his knees with forehead to the ground before DOLSOE: CHOI.
scenes.S58: Spring in a Joseon village: happy villagers receiving sacks of rice, a little child hugging a rice sack, smoke rising from thatched-roof chimneys, blossoming trees.
